preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The length of the array is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line) == N for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in output_line) for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(max(output_line) == min(output_line) or 2 in output_line for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: For each output line, the maximum element is not the same as the minimum element, and 2 is present if the length is greater than 1.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(output_line.count(x) % 2 == 0 for x in output_line) for output_line in output)
postconditions.description: For each output line, there does not exist a subarray with all elements occurring in even frequency.
